title: SQL Injection in /vulnerabilities/sqli/ (UNION-based)
description: The id parameter is vulnerable to UNION-based SQL injection allowing extraction of arbitrary data from the MySQL database, including database user and database name.
poc: Probe request against http://127.0.0.1:8080/vulnerabilities/sqli/; observed proving result from prior stage handoff: SQL injection confirmed via boolean condition 1' OR '1'='1. The query returns user data when condition is true.
proof: SQL injection confirmed via boolean condition 1' OR '1'='1. The query returns user data when condition is true.
